translation_notes: Textbook add_isolated: one unconditional marker triple plus three .add() calls on the same subject, each behind its own independent boolean flag (with_download / with_access / with_rights). Because the three are independently conditional, they cannot be merged into one +{ s p1 o1 ; p2 o2 } without duplicating the +{ } under every flag combination -- so they stay 4 separate @graph as g / +{ } statements, one per original .add(), guarded by the same if as before.

`g = Graph()` -> `@graph as g` (create-and-designate form); a hard-coded IRI (the marker triple's object, and the two fixed download/access URLs) became a plain <...> IRI island rather than a prefixed name, since they are not in any bound namespace.

Context shim fdpneo_namespaces_context.py restores DCAT/DCT (fdpneo_server.shared.namespaces is not installed) with the real IRIs from src/fdpneo_server/shared/namespaces.py -- both also happen to be rdflib's own well-known DCAT/DCTERMS at the same IRIs.
Driver: entry+calls (isomorphism oracle) on the returned graph, 3 flag combinations (all on, all off, mixed) so each flag's effect is independently checked rather than only the all-True default.
Verified the fixture is not a hollow green: renaming dcat:accessURL to dcat:accessURI in translated.ldpy flips the check to FAIL (4 vs 4 triples, not isomorphic).
